name: Generation Curses
overview: Scripture reveals a complex truth about generational consequences of sin: while God disciplines families by visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children to the third and fourth generation when they hate Him (Exodus 20:5; Numbers 14:18), individual responsibility remains central. The Bible clearly states that each person is accountable for their own sin, and neither children nor fathers will bear the penalty for one another's iniquities (Deuteronomy 24:16; Ezekiel 18:20). This balance underscores both God's justice and mercy in dealing with sin across generations.
